free_tier.stated: Freshworks support states flatly: 'There is no storage limit on the Freshdesk platform. All the data is stored in Cloud.' Per-attachment 20 MB (15 MB on Sprout/trial).

egress.terms: No egress meter; attachments are served from `cdn.freshdesk.com` (S3-backed).

tooling: Freshdesk REST API (multipart attachments), Python/PHP samples in `freshworks/fresh-samples` (`create_ticket_attachment.py`). No rclone backend.
chaining: 'No storage limit' x unlimited free-tier portals would be the best finding in the niche — but the free tier is a 6-month program, not a standing plan, so the realistic multiplier is 6 months x N portals.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 15 MB (Sprout/trial) to 20 MB per conversation. request-rate: Growth 100 req/min, Pro 400, Enterprise 700, with per-endpoint sub-limits (Ticket Create 50/min on Growth). Retention: 'no storage limit' is unqualified in the article, but the Free Program ends after 6 months.
reliability_note: The 'no storage limit' claim is real and current, but it is a claim about a paid platform. Free access is a 6-month program with 2 agent seats; files >20 MB must be hotlinked from Dropbox/OneDrive, i.e. Freshdesk is not the store.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
